gramlot-js-server 0.2.6 stops teaching the remote Source and follows `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.7. The packages have no code changes; their version follows the repository.

## Changes

- Documentation
  - Source methods (`source(...)`, `remoteSource`) are not yet part of the page-writing API: they arrive together with the `remote` grammar attribute and `@endpoint`. The guides GN-115-020 and GS-115-020 keep their identifiers and now carry only this note; the introductions, the tutorial, the deployment, configuration, reference and troubleshooting pages no longer show the pattern. The mechanism stays: the route `POST /gramlot/source`, the `sourceUrl` option and the Worker operation `source`.
  - The gallery family `c` is `c01`–`c08`: gramlot-examples 0.2.7 removed the remote Source example and moved the end-to-end page to `c08`. The gallery under `/js` lists 35 routes.
- Tests
  - The browser checks of the gallery follow gramlot-examples 0.2.7: the old `c08` is gone, the end-to-end page `c08` no longer loads a remote branch.
  - The gallery tests run against `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.7.
  - The CI fixtures `serverless/examples/source-live` and `serverless/examples/inline-code` say in their first line that they test the Worker `source` operation and are not examples of the page-writing API.

## Verified

Node.js 23.11 and Bun 1.3.14, with the core 0.2.7 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.7: the tests of the three packages (server 14, serverless 32, create 3); in Chromium 153 the server checks on Node and Bun, the exported files (hello world, Source live, inline code), the quick start and the page module, the gallery from disk (34 examples), the gallery on Node and Bun under `/js` (33 examples) and the templates of `@gramlot/create`.
